d408867b13999b14.desc: Tuesday – Friday, 10am – 3pm, Guided Tours (groups of 5 or more) and Self-guided Visits Saturday, 10am – 2pm, Self-guided Visits Only* Discover the fascinating world of birds at the Western Foundation of Vertebrate Zoology, also known as the Camarillo Bird Museum! Explore some of the world’s largest collection of eggs, nests and other specimens while learning about bird species, habitats, and the research that helps advance our understanding of avian life.
